items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: And I got Kid Clayton with me on that job. Kid Clayton, Harold De Jong, Sae, Eddie Summers on trombone, Smitty on piano.

ctx.x: Ever have Kid Clayton and Sam Lee outside?

Well, yeah, Clayton's worked with me too but not, not together with Noon and Sam. I mean, as a matter of fact, Clayton will be working with me Mardi Gras there. I have my own job Mardi Gras there right here on Royal Street at the American League in Coni and Ro. And I got Kid Clayton with me on that job. Kid Clayton, Harold De Jong, Sae, Eddie Summers on trombone, Smitty on piano.
